import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_marketplace_oep_state_level_2024.xlsx', sheet_name='(9) Dental')
sbm_df = df[(df['Platform'] == 'SBM') & (df['State Name'] != 'Total')].copy()
col_name = [c for c in sbm_df.columns if 'Standalone Dental Plan' in str(c)][0]
sbm_df[col_name] = pd.to_numeric(sbm_df[col_name], errors='coerce')
top3 = sbm_df.sort_values(by=col_name, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3['State Name'].tolist()

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_marketplace_oep_state_level_2024.xlsx', sheet_name='(7) by Metal Level')
# Filter for HC.gov platform and exclude Total rows

hc_states['Gold'] = pd.to_numeric(hc_states['Gold'], errors='coerce')
top4 = hc_states.sort_values(by='Gold', ascending=False).head(4)
result = top4['State Name'].tolist()
